tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating a urinary tract infection. Mild proteinuria and hematuria are present. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of targeted antibiotic therapy.
